notes.title: AnShi Patch Release V1.4 Mar. 1st 2021
notes.content:
[b]Features[/b]
[list]
* Creature: Added hoverboard dash / impulse effect (press Jump and then press jump again in air)
* General: Add wormhole animation to wormhole travels
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
* General: Update translations
* General: Clean game data in kill zone / new game
* Zone 1: Reduced hoverboard camera arm length in caves
* Zone 2: Fixed collisions after parachute cut scene in canyons
* Zone 3: Add particle system to power generator
* Zone 3: Fix dying garden cut scene trigger
* Zone 3: Lower garden add block to energy bridges
* Zone 3: fixed missing texture in lower gardens
[/list]

notes.title: AnShi Improvement Release Feb. 27th 2021
notes.content:
Hi, I just released another bug fix release :).

Following changes were made

[list]
[*] Main Menu: Added confirmation dialog to "New Game" after a new game has started
[*] General: Changed killbox behavior to reload game
[*] Zone 1: Updated walk behavior in space ship
[*] Zone 1: Reduced hoverboard speed in start area for better gameplay experience
[*] Zone 1: Moved elders return location behind the blue sphere
[*] Zone 1: Improved animation sequences in space ship
[*] Zone 3: Improved gameplay experience lower garden entrance
[/list]
